scope: Native public NAPI; split FDB prefixes; single-node diagnostic; 400 iterations, 64 workers, 4KiB complete-byte oracles. No QUIC, mounted-filesystem, physical IOPS or production capacity measurement.
limitations: Earlier identical split-prefix inode runs failed opening ESTALE with zero oracles; there is no successful prior throughput denominator.
Each workload is one short trial; setup excluded from workload time. Namespace removal and driver shutdown do not delete retained immutable block data.
Policy fix independently reviewed separately; these results do not establish canonical Cloudflare R2 qualification.
